summary: Checker report is clean (all rules PASS), and the skyline holds Sky's decisions: SpaceHQ 252 dominant, rivals ≤ 200, harbour band ≤ 108. One fault: Vantage's note puts the Sphere Gardens banks on plots, which the station standard forbids. Open questions, not faults: liner-berth tip 102.6 (kit note) vs 103.7 (skyline tiers); SkyBridge span 70 vs 88 between plan passages; Skyport platforms x 520–570 vs footprint 523–567 (SK-3 passes; portal extent not in my passages); grammar §4 20 % height variety (not retrieved; Aster to decide).

faults.fault: Vantage's note says Sphere Gardens' banks use "the two open forecourt plots beside Circus Road's 6 m median". The station standard says banks land on public ground (pavement, median, mall, park, quay), never on a plot. The checker's L-5 and N-P2 measure all banks on public ground, so the note is either false to the candidate or describes a breach. Vantage states the note was unverified hand work.
faults.fix: Restate where the S1/gardens banks land, one each side of the line, as public ground (Circus Road pavement, median or park) in line with L-5. If the entrance does depend on plot land, move the banks onto public ground or hand the ground to Datum to declare as public space.
